instruction: My manager has asked me for my headshot picture over email, to which I have drafted a response. But I have mistakenly attached my cv instead. Please fix it and send the email. The headshot is in my file system.
notes: Three apps: supervisor, gmail, file_system (constant file-system). The task records (headshot-draft, cv-attachment, headshot-attachment) are domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can state the goal without parameters. Attachment state is tracked by (attached ?a ?d); remove/upload require (not (sent ?d)), so the attachment set at send time is what the sent email carries, avoiding conditional effects. Flow: find the draft (show_drafts with query 'headshot'), read its attachment id (show_draft), remove the cv attachment, log into file_system, locate the headshot file (show_directory with substring 'headshot', recursive=true), upload it to the draft (attachment_file_paths = [headshot path], with the file_system token), then send the draft, which deletes the draft and creates the email with exactly the headshot attachment. Token objects are placeholders filled from the login responses.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'app', 'record', 'flag', 'attachment', 'substring', 'token', 'query', 'username', 'password', 'person', 'file-path', 'draft'}
